turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hi, this is Taylor calling from Maple Bank. This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: May I speak with Ramon Ramos?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Speaking.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Before we continue, can you please confirm your date of birth?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Sure, it's [PII].

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. And is your mailing address still the same?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, same address.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you. I'm calling about your account with Maple Bank, which is past due.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me just pull up your account. One moment please.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for waiting, I have it here.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: The amount past due today is $211.97.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I'm not able to pay that right now. I lost my overtime at Northern, so I'm making less now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'm sorry to hear that. We have hardship options, like a reduced payment for three months. Would you like me to review that with you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that would help.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I'll make a note on the file the hardship team can review your situation.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You should hear from them within a few business days.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: I can pay 64 the 14th.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Just to confirm, a payment of $64.30 on August 14. I'll send you a payment link.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that's all.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for your time today. You'll receive a confirmation by text. Have a good evening.
